RULES
Brief
Platforms:TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts.
MANDATORY: Tag @Coinbase in EVERY post. Instagram @coinbase · TikTok @coinbase. On YouTube, use the official Coinbase handle shown by the platform.
MANDATORY: Include #ad OR #partner in EVERY caption/description. Both the Coinbase tag and one disclosure hashtag must be clear and readable.
Posts missing either @Coinbase or #ad/#partner do NOT qualify for campaign payout.
Use only the approved Coinbase/ClipHaus folder or other explicitly cleared material.
Make your own edit: crop, reframe, caption, subtitle, stitch, add a joke, reaction or POV.
Keep the meaning of quotes and reactions intact. Do not misrepresent people or events.
Use Aston Martin Aramco F1, Coinbase and sponsor names/logos exactly as supplied and unaltered.
